title: Configuration with an added work tape
statement: Let $m$ and $\ell$ be natural numbers, let $S$ and $Q$ be types, and let $y$ and $z$ be Boolean lists with $|z|=\ell+|y|$. Given a state $q\in\mathrm{Option}(Q)$, a configuration $c$ with $m$ work tapes on input $y$, a tape $r:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, and a head position $p\in\mathbb{Z}$, form a configuration with $m+1$ work tapes on input $z$: its state is $q$, its input-head position is shifted by $\ell$, its work tapes are those of $c$ followed by $r$, its work-head positions are those of $c$ followed by $p$, and its output is the output of $c$.
